_runs.note: Inert run metadata. The committed test reads only clips[].wav, clips[].reference and _cer_tolerance; everything here is provenance.

positive.order: sequential, run 1 then run 2 then run 3, same WAV, fresh browser context each time

_runs.finals_semantics: clips[0].finals records the NORMALIZED transcript value for each Green run in run order. These are normalized observed/entailed values, NOT raw transcript strings. The frozen test does not expose sent.text, so the raw string with its original whitespace and punctuation was never observed and is deliberately not invented here. Each entry is entailed exactly: the test asserts distance(normalize(sent.text), normalize(reference)) / max(1, 17) <= 0.01, and floor(0.01 * 17) = 0, so a passing run forces edit distance 0 and therefore normalize(sent.text) === ADDANEDGEFROMCTOA.

negative_witness.entailment: the codec refused the non-add-edge decision before appendDecision, so no Decision was appended and the session graph was unchanged; the host graph binding is module-scoped and not exposed, so this is structural entailment and not direct observation
